name: Adjoint Functor Constraint Canonical
description: Adjoint functors F⊣G: hom(F(A),B) ≅ hom(A,G(B)); z3 encodes homset bijection via QF_LIA; rejects cardinality mismatches and triangle identity violations; proves adjoint transpose naturality

z3.reason: Encodes adjoint functor constraint |hom(F(A),B)| = |hom(A,G(B))| via integer linear arithmetic; proves cardinality mismatches are UNSAT; validates triangle identities εF∘Fη=id_F and Gε∘ηG=id_G; identifies adjoint regimes via QF_LIA homset bijection

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for integer linear constraints

sympy.reason: Derives adjoint pair F⊣G and unit η:Id→GF, counit ε:FG→Id; proves triangle identities and natural transpose via symbolic manipulation; validates adjoint transpose naturality in both arguments

adjoint_homset_bijection_basic.interpretation: Adjoint functors F⊣G: |hom(F(A), B)| = |hom(A, G(B))| = 4; natural bijection established via adjoint transpose

triangle_identity_unit_counit.interpretation: Triangle identities for F⊣G: (εF)∘(Fη)=id_F and (Gε)∘(ηG)=id_G both satisfied; unit η and counit ε coherent

adjoint_transpose_natural.interpretation: Adjoint transpose hom(F(A), B) → hom(A, G(B)) is natural in both A and B; commutes with morphisms in domain and codomain

homset_cardinality_mismatch_unsat.interpretation: Cardinality mismatch: |hom(F(A), B)| = 5 but |hom(A, G(B))| = 8; adjoint transpose cannot be bijective; F⊣G fails

triangle_identity_broken_unsat.interpretation: Triangle identity violation: (Gε)∘(ηG)≠id_G; unit and counit incoherent; adjoint structure broken

asymmetric_morphisms_unsat.interpretation: Morphism count mismatch: F provides 7 morphisms but G accounts for only 3; adjoint transpose impossible; not a true adjoint pair

adjoint_trivial_functor.interpretation: Adjoint boundary case: both hom sets have 0 morphisms; trivial adjoint (terminal/initial object case)

adjoint_identity.interpretation: Identity adjoint: id⊣id with |hom(A,B)| = |hom(A,B)| = 2; adjoint holds trivially for identity functors

adjoint_scaling_invariance.interpretation: Adjoint relation persists under scaling: if |hom(F(A),B)| = |hom(A,G(B))|=n, then scaled copies maintain equality; bijection is stable
